title: Design-system component and block catalog entry

accessible-name.definition: Interactive control exposes a programmatic name.
accessible-name.verification: Inspect accessible name in browser accessibility tree or run qa button-accessible-name.

alternative-text.verification: Run qa img-alt and inspect image intent.

aria-disabled-visual-state.definition: aria-disabled state has a visible non-active presentation.
aria-disabled-visual-state.verification: Inspect the aria-disabled state in browser.

decorative-icon-hidden.definition: Decorative icon is excluded from the accessibility tree.
decorative-icon-hidden.verification: Inspect aria-hidden in markup and accessibility tree.

focus-visible.definition: Keyboard focus has a visible indicator without forcing mouse focus styling.
focus-visible.verification: Tab through the control in browser.

form-label.definition: Form control has an associated visible or accessible label.
form-label.verification: Run qa input-label and inspect for/id or accessible name.

interactive-nesting.definition: Interactive controls are not nested within one another.

native-disabled.definition: Native disabled controls preserve their semantic disabled state.
native-disabled.verification: Inspect disabled attribute and keyboard behavior.

native-button.definition: Action is represented by a native button when navigation is not intended.
native-button.verification: Inspect tag name and type attribute.

semantic-heading.definition: Section title uses an appropriate heading element.
semantic-heading.verification: Inspect heading outline in browser accessibility tools.

semantic-landmark.definition: Major page region uses an appropriate landmark element.
semantic-landmark.verification: Inspect landmark tree in browser accessibility tools.

status-text.definition: Dynamic status can be announced when product behavior requires it.
status-text.verification: Inspect role=status or aria-live only where the status changes dynamically.
